crm_notes: Account brief: Proxima is a large global e-commerce platform planning to replace an in-house ANN+rerank stack. Goal: 100M–1B+ vectors across product, reviews, and user behaviors.
Primary metrics: target p95 end-to-end rerank latency 60-120ms at peak; throughput 6k qps sustained; unit cost target <$0.001/query after optimizations.
Current infra: hybrid cloud + on-prem search nodes; evaluating dedicated GPU pools vs Redwood Dedicated with VPC peering.
They care deeply about batching, prefix/KV caching, and quantization to reduce token/GPU cost. Want automatic fallback to smaller model variants for cold writes.
Quote from CTO (02/28 perf deep dive): 'We need predictable unit economics at scale — 1B vectors mustn't double our infra budget.'
Security: strict residency for EU customers, mandatory KMS integration and full audit logs. Will require SOC2/ISO27001 evidence and an HSM/KMS clause in contract.
POC so far: ingest pipeline built (Spark -> vectorizer), 20M vectors imported to Redwood Dedicated pilot cluster; rerank latency measured in staged test: 85ms p95 for top-10 with optimized batching.
Cost sensitivity: finance asks for modeled TCO showing cost per query at 100M, 250M, 500M, 1B vectors including storage, compute, and egress.
Integration asks: connectors to S3/MinIO, support for IVF/HNSW index variants, deterministic routing policy per region, and canary rollouts for model upgrades.
